title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. You'll set technical direction, own reliability and cost, and stay close enough to the work to make good calls during an outage or a hardware refresh. We are a hybrid office, and offer flexibility around which days are in-office and which can be worked remotely.Your Tasks:Lead the teamHire, coach, and grow infrastructure engineers. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub Actions.Observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Honeycomb.Background in game services or other low-latency, high-concurrency systems.Experience with hybrid on-premise and cloud environments, or migrations between them.Our stackOur cloud platform is a set of Golang microservices in AWS, built around a service gateway and RabbitMQ message queues. On-premise, we run our own servers and Cisco network gear in the datacenter, managed with Ansible and Python.Area.Tools.Languages.Golang, Python.Messaging.RabbitMQ, NATS.Data.DynamoDB, Redis.Cloud.AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateways, EKS).Datacenter.Cisco routers, PXE boot, Ansible.Automation and CI/CD.Terraform, TeamCity.What We Can Offer You:The chance to work on EVE Online with talented, ambitious colleagues.A multicultural workplace that encourages growth and new ideas.Dual-monitor workstation and a flexible work environment.An active fun division that hosts regular events.A canteen with weekly breakfast and lunch menus, plus drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual. performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.Mobile phone and mobile plan.Home internet.Conditional monthly transportation grant.Free on-site doctor and other on-site. services at a discount.Relocation package.Please submit your application in English by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/29d70840-8361-4fc9-ac2a-de524d85fba0

title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. You'll set technical direction, own reliability and cost, and stay close enough to the work to make good calls during an outage or a hardware refresh. We are a hybrid office, and offer flexibility around which days are in-office and which can be worked remotely.Your Tasks:Lead the teamHire, coach, and grow infrastructure engineers. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub Actions.Observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Honeycomb.Background in game services or other low-latency, high-concurrency systems.Experience with hybrid on-premise and cloud environments, or migrations between them.Our stackOur cloud platform is a set of Golang microservices in AWS, built around a service gateway and RabbitMQ message queues. On-premise, we run our own servers and Cisco network gear in the datacenter, managed with Ansible and Python.Area.Tools.Languages.Golang, Python.Messaging.RabbitMQ, NATS.Data.DynamoDB, Redis.Cloud.AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateways, EKS).Datacenter.Cisco routers, PXE boot, Ansible.Automation and CI/CD.Terraform, TeamCity.What We Can Offer You:The chance to work on EVE Online with talented, ambitious colleagues.A multicultural workplace that encourages growth and new ideas.Dual-monitor workstation and a flexible work environment.An active fun division that hosts regular events.A canteen with weekly breakfast and lunch menus, plus drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual. performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.Mobile phone and mobile plan.Home internet.Conditional monthly transportation grant.Free on-site doctor and other on-site. services at a discount.Relocation package.Please submit your application in English by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/29d70840-8361-4fc9-ac2a-de524d85fba0

title: Assistant Archivist
description: Role ProfileThe successful candidate will report to the Librarian & Archivist, to process and catalogue incoming collections of archives and promote the content of the Library’s extensive holdings. The candidate will be part of the Library team and contribute to its ongoing work and outreach.BackgroundThe Library of the Representative Church Body provides a repository for the Church of Ireland’s archives, manuscripts and related objects which tell the story of the Church’s community. These include records from parishes throughout Ireland, the archives of the Church’s dioceses, cathedrals, architectural drawings, the administrative records of the Representative Church Body and its multiple committees, and thousands of manuscripts relating to the Church’s people, buildings and activities, spanning from medieval times to the present. Book2Net Lizard, Tocosa, Silverfast9). Knowledge / Skills    Essential•    Excellent communication skills including making presentations and engaging with relevant stakeholders•    Experience curating small displays for exhibition•    Proficient in Microsoft Access (including database management and reporting)•    Experience in developing and managing websites and organisational social media accounts, including updating content and maintaining an online presence.•    Excellent organisational and inter-personal skills with proven ability to work to deadlines and prioritise workloadsDesirable•    Experience researching and writing content for publications including online and print content

description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Pianificare ed eseguire validazione/verifica (accuratezza, ripetibilità/riproducibilità, linearità, range, selettività, robustezza, carryover, LOD/LOQ) e confermare la tracciabilità metrologica tramite CRM. Definire e mantenere i budget di incertezza di misura (preparazione campione, calibrazione, performance strumentale) in linea con applicazione e decision rule. Redigere e mantenere piani/report di validazione e documenti controllati (SOP/WI) con gestione revisioni e valutazione impatti delle modifiche; Data integrity e gestione dati: garantire acquisizione, elaborazione e reporting secondo procedure controllate (configurazione strumenti, audit trail, versioning, calcoli tracciabili). Eseguire review tecnica e validazione risultati (stato calibrazioni, conformità QC, integrità campioni, controlli di plausibilità). Gestire archiviazione sicura e recupero dei dati grezzi/record con leggibilità nel lungo periodo e accessi controllati. Gestire i dati in modo strutturato con LIMS e fogli validati applicando principi ALCOA++. Condurre indagini e azioni correttive per non conformità, eventi di data integrity o QC fuori specifica; implementare CAPA e verificarne l'efficacia; Esecuzione analisi chimiche avanzate: svolgere analisi con metodi validati, inclusa preparazione campioni (pesata, digestione, diluizione), calibrazione e verifiche QC. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). Interpretare risultati per caratterizzazione materiali, monitoraggio corrosione, failure analysis e supporto al processo; comunicare conclusioni agli stakeholder. Supportare definizione di decision rules e dichiarazioni di conformità coerenti con requisiti cliente/norme; Gestione subfornitori e audit: valutare tecnicamente report di laboratori esterni (equivalenza metodo, incertezza, evidenze di tracciabilità, adeguatezza QC). Supportare qualifica e follow-up fornitori come esperto di analisi chimiche; contribuire a preparazione ed esecuzione audit. Supportare audit interni/esterni (enti di accreditamento, clienti) fornendo evidenze oggettive su validazione, incertezza, competenza e data management; Requisiti: Laurea in Chimica, Chimica Analitica, Ingegneria Chimica o diploma 5 anni indirizzo chimico; Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel ruolo all'interno di laboratori industriali accreditati ISO/IEC 17025; Esperienza diretta in attività di analisi composizione metallica e analisi metalli in matrice acquosa ICP-OES/ICP-MS; Conoscenza livello B2/C1 lingua inglese; Cosa offriamo: Inserimento diretto in azienda; CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria; Retribuzione prevista compresa tra €37.000,00 to €48.500,00 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alla mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro cliente è una realtà italiana solida e strutturata attiva nelle grandi opere/infrastrutture, con forte presidio su cantieri, impianti e mezzi , che ci ha incaricato di ricercare per la sede di Sondrio un/una SENIOR BUYER - Lavori/Servizi/Forniture | Grandi Opere/Infrastrutture (Sondrio) La risorsa riporterà al Responsabile Ufficio Acquisti e avrà il compito di assicurare l'attività di approvvigionamento di lavori, servizi e forniture in ambito grandi opere e infrastrutture pubbliche, in funzione delle esigenze produttive dei cantieri per la parte plant & equipment. Nello specifico, la risorsa: Gestisce l'albo fornitori: selezione, aggiornamento e proposta di approvazione in linea con procedure interne. Prepara e invia le richieste di offerta, raccoglie le proposte e coordina le verifiche tecniche con le funzioni richiedenti. segue la negoziazione economica e contrattuale (tempi, condizioni, SLA), con attenzione a qualità, lead time e ottimizzazione costi. Desideriamo entrare in contatto con Senior Buyers in possesso di laurea in Ingegneria (Civile, Gestionale, Edile, Meccanica, dei Processi) oppure Diploma di Geometra con esperienza negli acquisti legati ai cantieri, in particolare su impianti e macchinari, materiali, ricambi e servizi (es. manutenzioni) e provenienza da contesti strutturati (ad es società di infrastrutture/costruzioni, EPC contractors, Oil & Gas, aziende produttrici di mezzi di movimentazione/sollevamento). È richiesta la conoscenza della normativa sugli Appalti Pubblici, una buona padronanza del pacchetto Office (soprattutto Excel) e, preferibilmente, familiarità con sistemi ERP (SAP). Completano il profilo autonomia operativa, capacità di lavorare in team e orientamento al risultato. Sede di lavoro: Sondrio con smart working 8 gg/mese. description: Grafton Engineering* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Per Azienda internazionale, leader nella progettazione e costruzione di macchinari per la produzione industriale, Automazione, Robotica e Converting, selezioniamo: SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Automation & Robotics Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nel reparto Engineering, contribuirai allo sviluppo di soluzioni software avanzate per macchine e impianti automatici, integrando automazione, robotica e visione artificiale, con focus su performance, affidabilità e sicurezza. In particolare ti occuperai di: Analisi di richieste tecniche post-vendita (upgrade, miglioramenti, bug fixing) e supporto alla definizione della soluzione (fattibilità e impatti). Sviluppo & commissioning automazione: PLC, Motion, HMI/SCADA (Siemens/Rockwell/Beckhoff/Codesys). Test/validazione/ottimizzazione in collaborazione con i referenti tecnici di plant. Troubleshooting e analisi di anomalie con approccio strutturato (raccolta evidenze, riproducibilità, proposta di fix). Produzione/aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica (specifiche di base, note di rilascio, report test). Collaborazione con team cross-funzionali (meccanica, elettrica, automazione) per integrazione e miglioramento continuo Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in Ingegneria (Automazione/Robotica/Informatica/Meccatronica/Elettrica-Elettronica o affini); gradita magistrale/specializzazione AI-Vision. 2-5 anni di esperienza in sviluppo software per automazione industriale, macchine/impianti, o sistemi complessi in contesti industriali. Programmazione: C++ e/o C# e/o Python; graditi OOP, UML, Design Patterns, DBMS. Familiarità con contesti di automazione industriale e integrazione software-hardware; gradita conoscenza di protocolli/fieldbus e ambienti Linux. Soft skills: analisi, problem solving, teamwork, collaborazione cross-funzionale. Inglese buono/fluente. Orario di lavoro: Full time 40 ore settimanali, dal lunedì al venerdì. Richiesta presenza in plant, con con possibilità di smart working fino a 8 giorni al mese. Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato; CCNL applicato: Metalmeccanico; Livello di inquadramento: B2. La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 45.000 lordi annui (RAL), definita in base all'inquadramento, alle mansioni e alle caratteristiche del profilo. Sono inoltre previsti mensa aziendale, piano welfare, pacchetto benefit dedicato alla cura della persona e formazione tecnica continua sulle tecnologie avanzate utilizzate all'interno del reparto Engineering. description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? title: supervisore di contact center
description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Gestire richieste e incidenti tramite Jira, effettuando una prima diagnosi e indirizzando le problematiche ai team specialistici o ai fornitori quando necessario. Supportare onboarding e offboarding IT, predisponendo postazioni e accessi di base. Collaborare con i team IT locali e di gruppo, nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e delle policy di sicurezza. Il profilo che cerchiamo Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Service Desk o Help Desk, indicativamente di 5-7 anni. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. Diploma tecnico o formazione equivalente in ambito informatico. Conoscenza della lingua inglese adeguata all'interazione con colleghi e team IT di gruppo. È gradita un'esperienza in contesti industriali o manifatturieri, utile a comprendere le esigenze degli ambienti produttivi e la criticità dei dispositivi a supporto della produzione. title: consulente legale
description: Grafton Office è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. For a client company operating in the technology and travel sector, we are looking for a: POLICY AND REGULATORY MANAGER - SOUTHERN EUROPE What will you be responsible for? Developing and implementing regulatory strategies and compliance solutions across Southern Europe, with a primary focus on Italy, Greece, Croatia and Turkey. Managing relationships with local and national governments, regulatory authorities, tax authorities and other institutional stakeholders. Monitoring and analysing tax and fiscal regulations, particularly those concerning short-term rentals, tourist tax collection, registration and data sharing. Managing agreements with Italian municipalities on tourist tax and supporting regulatory negotiations and legislative initiatives. Collaborating with legal, product and international teams to develop compliance tools, regulatory policies and solutions. Preparing policy papers, regulatory analyses and position statements, while identifying partnership opportunities with public institutions and external stakeholders. Do you have the following skills and qualifications? At least 7 years of relevant experience in tax, fiscal, regulatory and compliance matters. A degree in Law or a tax-related field is mandatory. Strong knowledge of the Italian regulatory framework and legislative processes; knowledge of other Southern European markets is an advantage. Proven experience in stakeholder management, institutional relations and complex project management. Excellent analytical, organisational, communication and negotiation skills. Fluency in Italian and English. Flexibility to travel frequently within Italy, Greece, Croatia and Turkey. Working hours: Full-time, 40 hours weekly. Contract offer: Employment through a fixed-term temporary agency contract. Applicable collective agreement (CCNL): Commerce. Classification level: Level 1. Salary: €84,000-€86,000 gross per year (RAL). Work location: Milan or Rome, with regular travel to Milan required for candidates based in Rome, including overnight stays, and frequent business travel across Southern Europe. If you have the skills and experience required for this role, we look forward to receiving your application! title: consulente in energia solare
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite-enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale #LI-CP Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-90K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio

title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description: .....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort- Terminplanung Tour- Ausschankbetrieb- Führerschein Klasse CEPersönliche Voraussetzungen:- Unabhängigkeit- Altersvorgabe 30-58- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusstInteresse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Fahrzeugführung, Gästebetreuung, Technisches Verständnis

title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. RAL indicativa 70-80k + bonus variabile 10% Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. description: Il nostro Cliente è un importante gruppo industriale italiano, leader nella manifattura per il settore food & beverage, con presenza internazionale e un percorso di sviluppo fondato su innovazione, investimenti e solidità operativa. Per potenziamento della funzione Acquisti tecnici a supporto dei plant, ricerchiamo un/una: Industrial Sr Buyer / Technical Procurement (CAPEX & MRO). La risorsa, riportando al Purchasing Manager, opererà trasversalmente sugli stabilimenti italiani con impatto diretto su continuità produttiva, governance della spesa tecnica e performance dei fornitori. Collaborerà quotidianamente con Engineering, Manutenzione e Plant Management, oltre che con Qualità/HSE, Finance e Legal. Gestirà relazioni con fornitori italiani e internazionali (OEM, integratori, service provider) e, per investimenti o accordi quadro rilevanti, supporterà l'escalation verso General Management e Proprietà. title: Database and network professionals
description: Il nostro cliente è uno dei principali System Integrator italiani specializzati in Networking, Data Center, Security e soluzioni Cloud, con una forte componente di progettazione infrastrutturale e una lunga storia nel mondo delle telecomunicazioni. Ci ha incaricati di ricercare un/a Senior Pre Sales Engineer - Networking che verrà inserito/a all'interno della Technology Unit NDCS della Business Unit PPS (Public & Private Sector) e opererà nell'area di Prevendita, contribuendo alla definizione di soluzioni innovative in ambito Networking, Data Center, Security e Cloud per clienti Enterprise e Pubblica Amministrazione. L'obiettivo del ruolo è supportare le strutture commerciali nella qualificazione delle opportunità, nella progettazione delle soluzioni e nella predisposizione delle offerte tecnico-economiche, collaborando con vendor, partner e team di delivery. Principali responsabilità - Supportare le attività di prevendita tecnica nell'ambito di gare, offerte e opportunità - commerciali in tecnologia multivendor. - Analizzare i requisiti tecnici e di business dei clienti. - Definire architetture e soluzioni infrastrutturali in ambito Networking e Data Center. - Predisporre documentazione tecnica, High Level Design, allegati di gara e documenti di - offerta. - Collaborare alla definizione della soluzione economica e alla stima degli effort progettuali. - Interfacciarsi con vendor e distributori. - Supportare PoC, workshop, demo e presentazioni tecniche. - Collaborare con Delivery e Operation. - Contribuire all'evoluzione dell'offerta aziendale. - Supportare il coordinamento tecnico di offerte complesse. Competenze tecniche richieste - Architetture IP Enterprise e Service Provider. - Routing e switching (OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Segment Routing). - Tecnologie LAN, WAN e Data Center. - Esperienza su soluzioni Cisco, HPE ed altri vendor. - SD-WAN e SDN. - Wireless Enterprise. - Cloud e Network Security. - Processi ITIL e Service Management. Requisiti - Esperienza di almeno 8-10 anni in attività specifiche nel ruolo di cui al profilo richiesto - Esperienza nella definizione di soluzioni complesse. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. - Disponibilità a trasferte. Sede di Lavoro: Milano CCNL Metalmeccanico, Livello B3 O Quadro A1 RALT (fisso + variabile): 70.000€ SW fino al 50%, Ticket da 9 euro. Possibilità di auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo La nostra organizzazione opera nel rispetto della parità di genere e con l'impegno di sostenere l'inclusività e la diversity. Invitiamo a sottoporre le candidature evitando di fornire informazioni relative a matrimonio, gravidanza, responsabilità familiari, stato di famiglia. #LI-AM2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: Mining, manufacturing and construction supervisors
description: Grafton LifeScience* is a dedicated team focused on enhancing the experiences, skills, and potential of candidates in Sales & Marketing, Clinical Research, Regulatory, and Operations within the Pharmaceutical and Medical sectors. We also specialize in roles related to customer support in the health-impacting distribution field (Pharmacies and Parapharmacies).We are a team of passionate professionals working to guide our candidates towards roles and corporate environments that best match their skills and expectations. In partnership with an integrated CDMO with around 60 locations worldwide, specializing in integrated sterile liquid and lyophilized product development and commercial manufacturing, we offer an opportunity for QC PDS Quality Operations Analyst Summary: As a QC PDS Quality Operations Analyst, you will join our collaborative PDS team, working cross-functionally in a GMP/GLP-regulated environment and contributing to the development and delivery of advanced products and technologies that help address global challenges in healthcare and environmental protection. Job Responsibilities: - The primary focus of this role will be the review and verification of analytical activities and documentation generated by the QC PDS laboratory, ensuring accuracy, completeness, data integrity, and compliance with applicable procedures and GMP/GLP requirements. - Review of analytical testing and documentation related to product release, stability studies, analytical method validation and transfer activities, and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), using standard analytical techniques and instrumentation such as HPLC, UV-Vis, FT-IR, and Pharmacopoeial methods. - You will also receive appropriate laboratory training to maintain the capability to operate as a QC PDS Laboratory Analyst. - When required, you may provide hands-on support to routine laboratory activities and analytical testing. title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.

Se laskee tilinpäätöksistä ja tapaamistiedoista, millainen rahoitus hankkeelle sopii ja mihin takaisinmaksu perustuu. - **Asiakasraportti tekee tuloksista ymmärrettäviä.** Asiakas saa raportin päätöksenteon tueksi, ja sinä saat pohjan keskustelulle rahoituksen vaihtoehdoista. - **Rahoittajapaketti kokoaa valmistellun aineiston.** Siitä näkyy, mitä yritys aikoo toteuttaa ja miksi rahoitus kannattaa. Kokemus yrittäjien kanssa toimimisesta antaa hyvän pohjan, mutta **tärkeintä on oikea ote**: kuuntelet asiakasta, haluat oppia ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun.Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos tartut oma-aloitteisesti uusiin asiakaskeskusteluihin, työskentelet huolellisesti ja haluat rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi pitkäjänteisesti.**Yhteistyömalli: toimit itsenäisenä yrittäjänä**Kyseessä on **yrittäjämalli, ei työsuhde**. title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

title: IT IMPLEMENTATION PROJECT MANAGER - SALESFORCE VS TEMENOS (H/F)
description: IT IMPLEMENTATION PROJECT MANAGER - SALESFORCE VS TEMENOS Contexte : Dans le cadre d'un programme stratégique de transformation de ses processus crédits, notre client, un acteur bancaire luxembourgeois, souhaite renforcer son dispositif de pilotage avec un Program IT Delivery Lead capable de conduire le delivery IT d'un programme complexe à fort impact métier, organisationnel et humain. Cet environnement doit l'encourager à s'épanouir et à se réaliser dans la vie. Chacun de nos collaborateurs, travaille dans l'intérêt supérieur de l'enfant, du dynamique et de sa famille.Mission :En collaboration avec l'équipe Relations partenaires et Donateurs, vous contribuez au développement durable des ressources financier/ières de la Fondation afin de soutenir le développement des compétences et de l'autonomie des enfants et des dynamiques qui nous sont confiés. Qualifications et compétences requises :Diplômes et compétences techniques :Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor, d'un Master ou d'un diplôme équivalent en communication, marketing, gestion, commerce ou dans un domaine apparenté.Vous disposez d'une expérience professionnelle réussie dans la collecte de fonds, le développement commercial, les partenariats, le marketing relationnel ou les relations institutionnelles.Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants.Vous possédez de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et de communication.Vous maîtrisez le luxembourgeois, le français, l'allemand et l'anglais.Compétences sociales et savoir-être :Vous appréciez le contact humain et le développement de réseaux.Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'organisation et d'autonomie, et êtes capable de gérer plusieurs projets simultanément.Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe et appréciez le travail collaboratif.Les atouts qui feront la différence :Une expérience dans l'utilisation et l'évolution d'un CRM (iRaiser, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics ou équivalent).Une bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à la qualité des données, au reporting et au suivi de la relation donateurs.Une bonne connaissance du tissu économique, associatif, institutionnel et politique luxembourgeois.Une forte affinité pour le secteur de l'Aide à l'Enfance et à la Famille, et un intérêt marqué pour les questions touchant au développement, à la protection et à l'accompagnement des enfants, des dynamiques et des familles, ainsi qu'une profonde sensibilité aux enjeux sociétaux et humanitaires. Profil Compétences techniques Disposer de solides connaissances en comptabilité générale et analytique;Maîtriser les processus de facturation, de contrôle administratif et de gestion des dépenses;Connaître les règles relatives à la gestion des fournisseurs et des marchés;Disposer de compétences en management, en pilotage d'un service et en gestion de projets;Savoir organiser les activités, définir les priorités et gérer des situations complexes;Maîtriser les outils informatiques de gestion comptable et financier/ière ainsi que les outils de reporting;Être capable d'analyser les données financier/ières et de proposer des pistes d'amélioration;Être titulaire d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B en cours de validité. Vous n'avez pas à choisir votre statut au moment de postuler : celui-ci est déterminé au terme du processus de recrutement, en fonction des conditions à remplir pour chaque statut. Le poste est également ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 6 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. ExpérienceVous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine. La House of Sustainability est une initiative de la Chambre de Commerce visant à soutenir et à faciliter la transition durable des entreprises luxembourgeoises. title: IT IMPLEMENTATION PROJECT MANAGER - SALESFORCE VS TEMENOS (H/F)

description: Sustainable Finance Project ManagerPermanent contract (CDI), full-time | Start: as soon as possible | Location: LuxembourgThe roleDo you enjoy bringing order to complex projects, following up on every action, and taking pride in documents that are clear, accurate and well-written? The LSFI is looking for a Sustainable Finance Project Manager to run its multi-stakeholder platforms, which bring together seniordecision-makers from the public and private sectors of the Luxembourg financial centre. You will work under the supervision of the Head of Sustainable Finance.As the central point of contact between the LSFI team and its stakeholders, advisory boards and working group members, you will make sure that every meeting is well prepared, every discussion is accurately recorded and every agreed action is followed through to completion.What you will do• Stakeholder Forum: organise the LSFI Stakeholder Forum from start to finish (dates, agendas, presentations, minutes) and use participant feedback to improve each edition.• Advisory Bodies (IIAB and SAB): run their secretariat together with their Chair and Vice Chair, and track agreed actions until they are completed.• Women in Finance (WiF) Charter: onboard new signatories, manage the annual data collection campaign, coordinate the Steering Committee and the founders, and steer the annual progress report through to publication with the data provider and consultant.• Working Groups and Taskforces: launch new groups on topics selected by Management, run their secretariat with the Chair and Vice Chair, and keep members focused on tangible outcomes.• Support the Head of Sustainable Finance: Contribute to other LSFI projects as assigned by the Head of Sustainable Finance (including but not limited to coordination, planning of activities, participating in events, desk-top research) and to the day-to-day activities of the team.What we expect from you• Outstanding organisation: you plan ahead, take ownership, and drive several projects in parallel and meet deadlines.• Attention to detail and precision: accuracy matters to you, whether in a set of minutes, a data file or a slide.• Excellent writing skills: you draft clear, concise and well-structured agendas, minutes, emails and reports, and you can summarise complex discussions.• Diplomacy and firmness: you are at ease with senior stakeholders and remain courteous but persistent on follow-ups and deadlines.• Adaptability: you handle shifting priorities calmly without losing sight of the essentials.Qualifications and experience• Master's degree (or equivalent) in business, finance, communications, political science or a related field.• At least 2 years of experience in project management, stakeholder coordination or a secretariat role, ideally in an association, a public body or the financial sector.• Genuine interest in sustainable finance; knowledge of the Luxembourg financial centre and experience in the field of sustainable finance are an advantage.• Excellent command of English, written and spoken; German, French and/or Luxembourgish are an advantage.• Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).Who we areThe Luxembourg Sustainable Finance Initiative (LSFI) (www.lsfi.lu) is Luxembourg's coordinating entity on Sustainable Finance. Acting as a centre of excellence and knowledge hub, it works with the whole financial ecosystem to accelerate the financing of the transition, with the ambition of making Luxembourg a global centre for sustainable finance. Guided by its Sustainable Finance Strategy 2030, the LSFI:• Builds expertise and leadership: acts as Luxembourg's expert on sustainable finance topics and regulation, sharing insights with financial institutions and policymakers and raising Luxembourg's international profile;• Mobilises the financial sector: runs working groups, taskforces and advisory boards, and drives initiatives such as the Women in Finance Charter to unlock high-impact, innovative projects;• Measures and communicates progress: publishes the annual Luxembourg Sustainable Finance Study, maintains a Resource Hub on regulation, standards and labels, and organises events such as the annual LSFI Summit and Masterclasses.The LSFI was founded in January 2020 by the Luxembourg Government (Ministry of Finance and Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity), Luxembourg for Finance (the agency for the development of the financial centre) and the High Council for Sustainable Development (Conseil Supérieur pour un Développement Durable).What we offer• A role at the heart of the Luxembourg sustainable finance ecosystem, working closely with key public and private decision-makers and experts in the field.• A small, committed team where initiative is valued and where you will be involved in many aspects of our work.• Flexible working hours and access to training in sustainable finance.• A gross annual salary between EUR 45,000 and EUR 55,000, depending on qualifications and experience.How to applySend your CV and cover letter via e-mail.As writing is central to this role, the quality of your cover letter will be part of our assessment.Submission deadline: 30 November 2026

integrated solutions that address clients' accounting, tax and broader business challenges.  This position is for you if: • You are a qualified accountant or are close to obtaining the qualification.• title: Medewerker meldkamer telecom!!

Je werkt met geavanceerde monitoringsystemen om problemen op te sporen en op afstand op te lossen. Lukt dat niet, dan schakel je de 2e in. title: IT supportmedewerker
description: Relevante werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie is vereist. Wijj zijn op zoek naar een IT Support Medewerker die collega-s ondersteunt bij IT-vragen en storingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers goed kunnen werken met hun systemen, software en apparatuur. Veel problemen los je zelfstandig op. Voor complexere storingen schakel je externe IT-partners in en bewaak je de voortgang.Naast de dagelijkse IT-ondersteuning werk je mee aan IT-projecten en verbeteringen. Je denkt mee over praktische oplossingen en draagt bij aan een betrouwbare en goed functionerende IT-omgeving.Wat ga je doen?*Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor collega-s met IT-vragen en zorgt ervoor dat meldingen zorgvuldig worden opgepakt en afgehandeld;*Je lost eerstelijnsproblemen op het gebied van hardware, software en randapparatuur zoveel mogelijk zelfstandig op;*Ook registreer en behandel je incidenten, serviceaanvragen en wijzigingen in een ticketsysteem.*Bij technische problemen met bijvoorbeeld Windows 11, Microsoft 365, printers en telefonie zoek je naar een passende oplossing;*Complexere storingen op netwerk- en serverniveau zet je door naar externe IT-partners. Je houdt de voortgang in de gaten en zorgt dat collega-s op de hoogte blijven;*Daarnaast stem je wensen van gebruikers en management af en werk je samen met IT-partners aan projecten en verbeteringen.Wat kun je verwachten?Je krijgt een afwisselende functie waarin je dagelijkse IT-support combineert met technische vraagstukken en projecten. Er is ruimte om zelfstandig problemen op te lossen, mee te denken over verbeteringen en je technische kennis verder te ontwikkelen.Interesse?Wil je meer weten over deze functie? Neem contact op met Petra Ukon, recruiter bij Jobintenz, via 06-34113726 of info@jobintenz.nl. Bij interesse informeren wij je graag nader over de functie en de arbeidsvoorwaarden.

title: Logistiek Medewerker bij MBI de Steenmeesters

title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
description: Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.Wie zoeken we?Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.Je hebt affiniteit met security.Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.Wat verwachten we niet?Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.Dat je pakken draagt.Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

title: Maintenance engineer
description: Je hebt ervaring in een soortgelijke functie. In deze functie zorg je ervoor dat gebouwen, technische installaties en ondersteunende middelen veilig, betrouwbaar en efficiënt blijven functioneren. Je houdt je bezig met preventief onderhoud, het oplossen van storingen en het doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.Je krijgt veel zelfstandigheid en ruimte om werkzaamheden te plannen, knelpunten aan te pakken en onderhoudsprocessen verder te verbeteren. De functie is ontstaan omdat de huidige collega over een tijdje met pensioen gaat.Wat ga je doen?Als Technisch Beheerder ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onderhoud en de technische staat van gebouwen, installaties en ondersteunende middelen binnen een productieomgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van verschillende afdelingen en schakelt waar nodig externe onderhoudspartijen in.Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:*Opstellen, beheren en uitvoeren van meerjarenonderhoudsplannen voor gebouwen en technische installaties.*Coördineren en uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, inspecties en periodieke keuringen.*Analyseren en verhelpen van technische storingen, zelfstandig of in samenwerking met externe specialisten;*Uitvoeren van kleine elektrotechnische, werktuigbouwkundige en facilitaire werkzaamheden;*Ondersteunen van de productie bij storingen aan stroomvoorzieningen, verlichting, perslucht en klimaatinstallaties;*Bewaken van keurings- en kalibratietermijnen en administratief vastleggen van de resultaten;*Coördineren van keuringen van elektrische arbeidsmiddelen en hijsgereedschappen;*Beheren en bestellen van technische materialen, gereedschappen, persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen en overige verbruiksartikelen;*Coördineren van afvalstromen volgens de geldende wet- en regelgeving;*Signaleren van onveilige situaties en bijdragen aan veiligheidsinspecties en verbetermaatregelen.Interesse?Wil je meer weten? title: Fitnessinstructeur
description: TAKEN EN VERANTWOORDELIJKHEDEN- Geef boeiende fitnessinstructie en groepslessen die leden van alle niveaus motiveren- Zorg voor de dagelijkse gang van zaken in de fitnessfaciliteit en een soepele, efficiënte dienstverlening- Ondersteun en motiveer klanten, alleen of in groepen, bij het opbouwen van gezonde, actieve gewoontes- Werk flexibel op locaties in de regio en pas je elke week aan een nieuw rooster aanWAT JIJ MEEBRENGT- Oprechte passie voor fitness en het helpen van mensen bij het opbouwen van gezondere gewoontes- Zelfverzekerde, energieke communicator die zowel individuen als groepen kan motiveren- Flexibel en aanpasbaar, en op je gemak bij wisselende werktijden op meerdere locaties- Betrouwbaar en zelfstandig, en op je gemak bij het werken met minimaal toezichtTwee merken. Één team. ROVA Health is wat er gebeurt wanneer twee gevestigde namen in gezondheid en welzijn niet langer naast elkaar, maar samen verder gaan. Gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw erfgoed van Westfield Health Group en gedreven door de overtuiging dat de manier waarop mensen leven, werken en herstellen fundamenteel is veranderd - wij bestaan om daar iets aan te doen. Dit is een platform met een doel, gebouwd door mensen die het graag goed doen. Als je bij ons komt werken, begin je niet zomaar een nieuwe baan. Je helpt mee bepalen wat er nu komt.Geen twee dagen zijn hetzelfde, en dat is precies de bedoeling. Als onze Fitness Coach ga je naartoe waar de energie het hardst nodig is.Je bent een energieke motivator die mensen in beweging brengt, alleen of in een groep, wat hun ervaring of energieniveau ook is. Samen met ons team help je de dagelijkse activiteiten van onze fitnessfaciliteiten te runnen en zorg je dat alles soepel blijft lopen voor onze leden.Je wordt ingezet in de hele regio, met flexibel ingeroosterde diensten van 7 uur. Geen twee weken zijn hetzelfde, en het kan zijn dat je op het laatste moment ergens nieuws wordt ingezet. Voor die flexibiliteit ontvang je een maandelijkse back-upbonus naast je salaris.

title: Sparagus - System Middleware Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced System Middleware Architect to shape the next generation of Middleware and application-framework architecture for a leading global technology company. You will design scalable Middleware and application-framework solutions supporting multiple application ecosystems across devices such as smartphones and PCs, while driving system performance, compatibility, and long-term architecture evolution.

Responsibilities

  • Define the architecture and technical roadmap for the system Middleware layer.
  • Design scalable solutions supporting multiple application ecosystems and cross-platform compatibility.
  • Solve system-level challenges in areas such as performance, memory, startup speed, stability, compatibility, and scalability.
  • Drive Middleware and application-framework solutions from architecture and design through implementation on commercial products.
  • Establish architecture standards, development guidelines, and quality mechanisms.
  • Track developments in operating systems, Middleware, and cross-platform application technologies.

Why join?

This is an opportunity to work on next-generation operating-system and Middleware technologies, tackling complex system-level challenges across multiple device and application ecosystems. The role is based in Amsterdam and offers a competitive compensation package and an international R&D environment.
  • Strong experience with Android or iOS application frameworks and system-level software development.
  • Hands-on experience with React Native, Flutter, or similar cross-platform frameworks.
  • Good understanding of operating-system architecture and implementation principles.
  • Experience solving complex architecture, performance, compatibility, or reliability challenges.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical teams.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Experience with Android, iOS, Fuchsia, Chromeos, or similar operating-system platforms.
  • Experience working with external technology or ecosystem partners.
  • Long-term professional experience in Europe and experience collaborating in international technical environments.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
