title: Junior Cloud RAN Layer 1 SW Developer
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity    Are you about to graduate, or have you recently completed your university studies in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field?  Join Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 organization and help build the technology that powers next-generation mobile networks.  Our teams develop performance-critical software at the heart of 5G and future radio systems. As a Junior Software Engineer, you will work alongside experienced developers and technical experts to learn how advanced wireless communication systems are designed, implemented, tested, and optimized.  This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and excited about solving challenging technical problems in a collaborative environment.    What you will do         Develop and maintain software in Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 platform.     Use AI-assisted engineering workflows to support activities such as developing code, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review.     Work with modern C++ and performance-critical software components.     Learn how 5G/6G radio systems and physical layer processing work.     Participate in feature development, debugging, testing, code reviews, and continuous integration activities.     Collaborate with software developers, architects, system engineers, and testers across global teams.     Contribute to software quality, test coverage, maintainability, and continuous improvement.     Explore and contribute to AI/ML-enabled features that may be implemented in the product, including prototyping, integration, testing, and evaluation together with experienced engineers.     Grow your technical skills through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience.     The skills you bring         Programming experience in C/C++, Python, Julia.     Foundational understanding of AI and machine learning concepts.     Practical experience using Python for data processing, experimentation, or machine learning through university coursework, thesis work, or personal projects.     Experience with Linux development environments, Git, unit testing, CI/CD, or cloud-native technologies.     Basic understanding of 5G, mobile networks, physical layer processing, or 3GPP concepts.     Ability to use AI-assisted development tools critically and responsibly.     Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.     Interest in software engineering, high-performance systems, and telecommunications.     Good communication skills in English.     Curiosity, collaboration, ownership, and a strong willingness to learn.     You do not need previous professional telecom or Layer 1 experience. We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility, and the motivation to grow.   Please send your CV in English.

title: Sr ASIC Verification engineer
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   Join Our Global Team and Shape the Future with Ericsson 5G Advanced!Senior ASIC IP Verification  – Be the Architect of Tomorrow Are you ready to take your career to the next level and play a pivotal role in advancing 5G technology? At Ericsson, we're not just shaping the future; we're pushing the boundaries with Ericsson 5G Advanced. This isn't just the next step in 5G—it's a revolutionary leap forward. As part of our international team, you'll work alongside world-class talent on cutting-edge ASIC projects. We're engaged in all Ericsson ASIC initiatives, creating a vast network and serving these with SoC-level IPs and subsystems. This includes Clock and Reset controllers, Top-level device processor subsystems, accelerators, chip-level trace and debug architecture, and all interfaces for inter-chip communication or control of external devices.  Imagine revolutionizing the driving experience with smart, connected vehicles or transforming entertainment with immersive virtual reality. Ericsson 5G Advanced is the key to enabling high-performing programmable networks that ensure consistent and superior user experiences. Why Ericsson? •    Pioneering Technology: Be part of our world-leading 5G RAN portfolio, with Ericsson 5G Advanced as a key enabler for high-performing programmable networks.•    People-Centric Culture: We put people first, focusing on your career aspirations and personal growth. Inclusiveness is at our core, and we celebrate diversity across our teams.•    Global Collaboration: Work closely with talented teams in Austin, US, while being based in our vibrant Lund, Sweden office.•    Fun and Engagement: Enjoy frequent social activities that foster team spirit and make work enjoyable.   What will you do    •    Take full responsibility for the verification of designs, whether at the block or subsystem level.•    Define and implement UVM-based test environments.•    Break down requirements to create a Verification Strategy and develop and execute a Verification Plan.•    Develop, run, and debug test cases to ensure design quality.•    Collaborate closely with other verifiers, designers, and architects.•    Continuously improve and optimize verification methodologies.•    Generate comprehensive documentation throughout the verification lifecycle.•    Develop competence in the technical domain. Skills you bring  •     Master’s in Electronic Engineering or equivalent.•     Minimum of 8 years in ASIC verification, with proven success in advanced SoC development.•     Deep understanding of ASIC technology, SoC, IP verification, and methodologies, with proficiency in System Verilog and UVM.•     Track record of successful cross-team and cross-site cooperation.•     Results-Driven Mindset: Results-driven, with a focus on meeting expectations and delivering high-quality results.   Additional Requirements: •    Experience with Formal Verification.•    Familiarity with Agile methodologies.   Preferred Skills: •    Experience with SystemVerilog Assertions.•    Understanding of radio access systems and their components.•    Expertise in low-power design verification.

title: Storage DevSecOps Engineer
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team     Join us to build, and run the storage services behind Ericsson R&D  Reliable storage helps Ericsson’s research and development teams design, test and deliver what’s next. Join the RCE NES Data Storage team and help evolve the services and infrastructure they depend on, from design and implementation to secure, dependable day-to-day operations.  This is an opportunity in our Data Storage team. We welcome recent graduates and candidates with up to around five years of relevant experience in storage systems or DevOps. You don’t need to be a security specialist: we’re looking for someone who wants to build and operate services with security built in. DevOps and infrastructure candidates are encouraged to apply.  What you’ll do  •    Turn requirements into practical, cost-effective storage service designs, and contribute to service architecture and improvements. •    Help install, configure, upgrade, patch, repair and retire storage hardware and software, primarily in on-premises environments, with growing connections to hybrid cloud. •    Automate repeatable tasks and improve how services are delivered and operated. •    Support service availability through proactive monitoring, alerts, audit and log reviews, and 2nd- and 3rd-line troubleshooting. •    Coordinate data migrations and work with users, operations teams, suppliers and vendors to deliver changes and resolve issues. •    Take part in asset, change, incident, problem and request handling; help manage access, identities, certificates and security zones. •    Apply Ericsson security requirements and good practice through risk and security assessments, quality assurance and business continuity planning. •    Keep service, system, project and operating documentation current; identify risks and impediments and suggest better ways of working.    Skills you’ll bring  •    A BSc or MSc in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering or a related field—or equivalent knowledge. •    Relevant experience, study or hands-on projects in storage, infrastructure, systems administration or DevOps; early-career applicants are very welcome. •    Interest in storage technologies such as SAN, NAS, DAS and cloud storage, and protocols such as SCSI, NFS or SMB. •    Familiarity with platforms such as NetApp, Dell, Pure or HPE, or the motivation to learn them. •    Interest in scripting and automation. Python, PowerShell and Ansible are useful; other languages and tools are welcome. •    A service-minded approach to reliability, security and ownership, plus clear communication and documentation skills in English. •    A collaborative, curious, can-do attitude and care for well-built services.    Experience with virtualization, containers, cloud, microservices, software architecture, agile development or continuous integration is beneficial, not essential.    Why Ericsson Lab Operations?  Work with an open team supporting services used by R&D around the world. You’ll contribute across the service lifecycle, collaborate with stakeholders and suppliers, and help make storage more reliable, secure and efficient. title: Enhetschef daglig verksamhet LSS
description: Värmdö är skärgårdens mötesplats med en unik kombination av naturens stilla skönhet och en mer stadslik livsstil. Vårt uppdrag är inte ett utan många: skola, fastigheter, socialtjänst, hamnar, vård, bibliotek, omsorg och många fler. Vi verkar för att alla Värmdöbor kan leva ett rikt och fritt liv. Vi vill vara de som möjliggör drömmen om en livskraftig trygg miljö för hem, familj och företag.Ska vi lyckas med det fullt ut måste vi ha olika kompetenser och arbeta tillsammans för en gemensam och tillitsfull arbetskultur, byggd på modiga, ansvarstagande medarbetare som förstår invånarnas behov och önskemål.Vår verksamhetVärmdö dagliga verksamhet erbjuder en bredd av olika verksamheter, från utegrupper till mer traditionell daglig verksamhet. Verksamheten utgår från deltagarnas individuella behov, intressen och önskemål och arbetar för att skapa en meningsfull och utvecklande vardag. Senaste åren har daglig verksamhet genomgått en stor utvecklingsresa med fokus på att ta tillvara varje individs förmågor och styrkor och genom att arbeta med delar av metoden supported employment.Nu söker vi en trygg och tydlig enhetschef som kan ledas verksamheten vidare med fokus på att stärka det pedagogiska arbetet, utveckla rätten till kommunikation och ta tillvara digitaliseringens möjligheter. Vi söker dig som ser det som en självklarhet att vara nära på plats i verksamheten.Ditt uppdragSom enhetschef har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamheten, personal, arbetsmiljö och budget. Arbetet är av strategisk och utvecklande karaktär men du kommer även att arbeta operativt och nära dina verksamheter. Att bygga relationer och samverka både internt och med externa samarbetspartners är ett prioriterat område. Kommunen har ett samverkansavtal och samverkan med fackliga företrädare är en viktig del av ditt arbete.Som enhetschef är du direkt underställd avdelningschef och ingår i avdelningens ledningsgrupp där du verkar utifrån en helhetssyn för hela avdelning Funktionsstöd och social- och omsorgskontoret.Din erfarenhetDen vi söker har:• Universitets-/högskoleexamen som socionom, beteendevetare eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.• Erfarenhet som chef inom vård- och omsorgsverksamhet.• Erfarenhet av arbete inom LSS-verksamhet.• Kunskap/erfarenhet inom utvecklande arbetsmiljöarbete• Erfarenhet av budgetansvar.• Förmåga att uttrycka sig väl, pedagogiskt och behärskar svenska på hög nivå, i både tal och skrift.• Vana att driva och leda förändrings- och utvecklingsarbete.• Erfarenhet av att leda stora personalgrupper.• Kunskap kring de lagar, föreskrifter och allmänna råd som gäller för verksamheten.Det är meriterande om du även har:• Erfarenhet av arbete inom daglig verksamhet.• Erfarenhet/kunskap om olika pedagogiska metoder.• Erfarenhet av att arbeta i en politiskt styrd organisation.• Erfarenhet av arbete med arbetsmarknadsfrågor.• Erfarenhet av IBIC.Dina personliga egenskaperSom person är du självgående och orädd. Du drivs av att lösa problem och trivs i en roll där du är både operativ och strategisk. Du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och är en naturlig ledare med en coachande och involverande ledarstil. Du kommunicerar tydligt, har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och en god analytisk förmåga. Du har förmåga att analysera och utifrån det dra slutsatser samt förmedla dem vidare i organisationen på ett tydligt sätt. Du är van att prioritera och fatta beslut utifrån ett helhetsperspektiv. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.AnsökanAnställningen omfattar heltid och är en tillsvidareanställning med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. Intervjuer sker löpande, så sök redan idag. I denna rekrytering kommer en bakgrundskontroll genomföras innan anställning erbjuds.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.Värmdö kommun erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag och semesterväxling till extra lediga dagar. Vi arbetar även aktivt för att skapa hälsofrämjande arbetsplatser med en god arbetsmiljö och tillämpar rökfri arbetstid.Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund. Vill du veta mer är du välkommen att kontakta oss, se kontaktperson nedan.Kontaktuppgifter till arbetstagarorganisationerna hittar du på https://www.varmdo.se/fackligaorganisationer eller via Servicecenter, 08-570 470 00. Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

title: Yard Manager
description: BM SHOWJUMPING ABExperienced Yard Manager – Professional Showjumping StableLocation: Skåne, Sweden Employment: Full-time, permanent position Salary: SEK 34,470–38,000 gross per month Accommodation: May be available by agreement Start date: By agreementAbout BM Showjumping ABBM Showjumping AB is a professional equestrian business based in Skåne, Sweden, specialising in showjumping horses.We are seeking an experienced, responsible and highly motivated Yard Manager to oversee the daily running of our equestrian facilities and the management, care and welfare of approximately 10–20 horses.This is a key position within our business, combining practical horse management, stable operations, staff supervision and the organisation of our competition activities.We are looking for someone who has substantial experience with competition horses, understands the demands of a professional showjumping environment and can take responsibility for maintaining the highest standards throughout the yard.Main duties and responsibilities1. Horse management and welfare    Taking overall responsibility for the daily care and management of 10–20 horses.    Organising feeding, watering, bedding, grooming and general horse care.    Monitoring the health, fitness, condition and welfare of each horse.    Arranging and coordinating veterinary, farrier and other specialist appointments.    Identifying potential health problems and ensuring appropriate action is taken.    Managing horse turnout, stable routines and individual care requirements.2. Stable and yard management    Managing the day-to-day operation of the stable and equestrian facilities.    Maintaining clean, safe and well-organised stables, paddocks and working areas.    Managing feed, bedding, equipment and other supplies.    Organising daily work schedules and stable routines.    Overseeing routine maintenance and ensuring facilities are maintained to a high standard.3. Staff supervision and organisation    Supervising and coordinating stable staff.    Allocating daily duties and monitoring the quality of work.    Ensuring staff follow established procedures for horse care and welfare.    Organising workloads around training, competitions and other operational requirements.    Maintaining a positive, professional and productive working environment.4. Riding and competition preparation    Riding and exercising horses in accordance with their individual training requirements and ability.    Assisting with the preparation of horses for showjumping competitions.    Coordinating competition schedules and transport arrangements.    Ensuring horses are appropriately prepared and cared for before and after competitions.    Understanding the particular needs of competition horses and maintaining their fitness and wellbeing.5. Administration and business operations    Maintaining daily records relating to horse care, health and stable activities.    Coordinating veterinary and farrier bookings.    Managing stock levels and ordering feed, bedding and supplies.    Assisting with scheduling, planning and general business administration.    Reporting operational issues and contributing to the efficient running of the business.Experience and qualificationsApplicants must demonstrate:    Significant professional experience working with horses.    Previous experience managing or supervising an equestrian yard or stable.    Strong knowledge of horse health, welfare, feeding and stable management.    Experience with competition horses, preferably showjumping horses.    Practical riding experience and the ability to exercise horses appropriately.    Experience organising staff and managing daily operational responsibilities.    Good organisational, administrative and communication skills.    The ability to work independently and take responsibility for decisions.    A reliable, flexible and hardworking attitude.A full driving licence is desirable. Experience driving horseboxes and transporting competition horses is an advantage.Formal equestrian qualifications are desirable, although substantial relevant professional experience will also be considered.Language requirementsGood spoken and written English is required.Employment conditions    Full-time employment.    Gross monthly salary of SEK 34,470–38,000, depending on experience and qualifications.    Working hours agreed in the employment contract.    Holiday entitlement in accordance with Swedish legislation.    Employment-related insurance and occupational pension arrangements.    Accommodation may be available by separate agreement.    Working arrangements will reflect the requirements of a professional equestrian business, including reasonable weekend and competition-period responsibilities.All employment conditions will comply with applicable Swedish employment legislation and the relevant collective agreement or established industry practice.International applicantsBM Showjumping AB welcomes applications from experienced international candidates, including applicants from outside the EU/EEA who require a Swedish work permit.The company is prepared to participate in the Swedish Migration Agency's employer-led work-permit application process for a suitable candidate.Any appointment will be conditional upon the necessary work and residence permissions being granted.How to applyPlease submit a CV and covering letter outlining your professional equestrian experience, previous yard-management responsibilities and relevant qualifications.Please include:    Your current country of residence.    Your experience with showjumping and competition horses.    Your previous experience managing a stable or supervising staff.    Your riding experience and qualifications.    Your availability and earliest possible start date.    Whether you currently have the right to work in Sweden or require a Swedish work     BM Showjumping AB Skåne, Sweden

title: People Business Partner
description: E.ON is one of Europe's largest operators of energy networks and infrastructure and a provider of innovative energy solutions. Our employees are constantly working to digitise the energy world, achieve net zero and connect everyone to good energy. To achieve this, we are focusing our actions on sustainability, digitalisation and growth. We strongly believe that differences make us stronger and welcome all people into our inclusive and diverse culture.Inom E.ON Energiinfrastruktur skapar vi energilösningar som gör skillnad för våra kunder och samhället. Nu välkomnar vi en People Business Partner som vill arbeta nära vår fjärrvärmeverksamhet. Du blir en del av vårt People-team och ingår också i ett större sammanhang med People Business Partners i andra E.ON-bolag och centrala specialistfunktioner. Din rollSom People Business Partner är du en nära partner till chefer och lokala ledningsgrupper och omsätter verksamhetens behov i konkreta HR-insatser. Rollen förenar strategiskt och taktiskt arbete med chefsstöd i vardagen.Du vägleder i frågor som rör organisationsutveckling, förändring, bemanning och kompetensförsörjning. Du stöttar också chefer i arbetsrätt, rehabilitering och komplexa personalärenden samt förbereder och genomför facklig samverkan och MBL-förhandlingar. Tillsammans med chefer och HSE arbetar du för en trygg och hälsosam arbetsmiljö, med fokus på bland annat organisatorisk och social arbetsmiljö och ett hållbart arbetsliv.Tillsammans utvecklar vi arbetssätt och beteenden som stödjer verksamhetens förflyttning. Här får du bidra med perspektiv på hur digitalisering och AI kan förenkla och utveckla People-arbetet.Du utgår från Malmö, Eftersom du stöttar verksamheter i Norrköping, Stockholm och Örebro med chefer på flera orter är resor en naturlig och återkommande del av uppdraget. Dina erfarenheterVi söker dig som har en relevant akademisk utbildning inom HR, beteendevetenskap eller motsvarande och bred erfarenhet av kvalificerat HR-arbete nära chefer och ledningsgrupper. Du har god kunskap om svensk arbetsrätt, kollektivavtal och facklig samverkan samt erfarenhet av rehabilitering och arbetsmiljöfrågor.Du är van vid att stödja förändring och att tillsammans med chefer omsätta verksamhetens behov i prioriteringar och aktiviteter. Du använder gärna HR-data som underlag och känner dig bekväm med digitala HR-system. Du kommunicerar tydligt på svenska och engelska och anpassar ditt stöd efter olika människor och situationer.Du förenar empati och lyhördhet med tydlighet och integritet. Med blicken på helheten tar du självständigt ansvar, bygger förtroende och vågar lyfta svåra frågor. För dig är det naturligt att dela kunskap, stötta andra och känna stolthet över det vi åstadkommer tillsammans. Hur är det hos oss?Hos oss möter du ett hjälpsamt team där vi delar kunskap och stöttar varandra. Du får utrymme att forma ditt arbete och bidra med dina perspektiv, med kollegor nära till hands som bollplank. Din chef Josefina har ett inkluderande och utvecklingsorienterat ledarskap som bygger på tillit, nyfikenhet och tydlig riktning. Hon tror på att de bästa resultaten skapas tillsammans och uppmuntrar till att utforska nya arbetssätt och utvecklas i uppdraget.På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin personliga hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 13 november kl 10.00.Då vi arbetar med samhällsviktig verksamhet är anställningen säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan anställning.För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Josefina Cederberg Wallin, josefina.cederberg-wallin@eon.se För fackliga frågor, vänligen kontakta:Mats Ekblom, +46 705 259188Akademikerna, Akademikerna@eon.seMattias Andolfsson, Ledarna, mattias.andolfsson@eon.seMats Lundberg, SEKO +46 730 499778

title: Tax Technology Consultant | Tax Technology & Operations | Stockholm
description: Do you want to help businesses turn complex tax rules into practical technology solutions? Join EY's Nordic Tax Technology and Operations team in Stockholm and work where indirect tax, finance and technology meet. The opportunity Digital reporting requirements are changing how companies manage VAT and e-invoicing. In this role, you will help clients understand what new requirements mean for their data, processes and systems, and support them from early analysis through implementation. You will collaborate with tax specialists, finance teams, IT architects, developers and technology providers across the Nordics and our wider international network. This role offers the opportunity to build specialist expertise in a fast-developing area while contributing to major client projects and the continued growth of our Nordic offering. Your key responsibilities Your responsibilities will be adapted to your experience and may include:     Lead client workshops to understand current processes, identify needs and define requirements.     Translate indirect tax and e-invoicing regulations into clear process and system requirements.     Design practical solutions and documentation that connect tax, finance and technology.     Work with client teams and delivery specialists to implement and test solutions, including SAP-based e-invoicing solutions.     Coordinate stakeholders and contribute insights on developments such as ViDA and real-time reporting. Skills and attributes for success You enjoy making complex topics easier to understand and can connect business needs with technology. You are comfortable working with different stakeholders and take a structured, collaborative approach to delivery. Qualifications     A university degree in taxation, business, finance, information systems, computer science or a related field.    Relevant experience in indirect tax, tax technology, finance transformation, ERP implementation or a comparable advisory environment.    The ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into clear processes, documentation or technology solutions.    Strong communication skills in English and the ability to work effectively with both business and technology stakeholders.    Knowledge of SAP, particularly SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (SAP DRC) Meritorious     Experience with VAT or GST, e-invoicing, digital reporting or tax compliance transformation.    Tax technology platforms such as Avalara, Vertex or Thomson Reuters.    Familiarity with Peppol, country-specific e-invoicing frameworks, ViDA or real-time reporting requirements.    Experience with requirements gathering, solution design, user acceptance testing, agile delivery or project coordination.    Experience working with multinational organisations, cross-border teams or large-scale transformation projects. As a person you are     Curious and motivated to learn in a fast-changing specialist area.    Analytical and solution-oriented, with an eye for both detail and the bigger picture.    Collaborative, clear and confident when working across tax, finance and technology teams. What we offer you     Continuous learning: Develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.    Success as defined by you: Tools and flexibility to make a meaningful impact, your way.    Transformative leadership: Insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs.    Diverse and inclusive culture: Be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice. Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. Please submit your application no later than 29th of November 2026. Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis. If you have questions about the role, please contact Oda Kristin Borgesen at Oda.Kristin.Borgesen@no.ey.com . For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Simon Aspler at Simon.Aspler@se.ey.com. Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. title: EY-Parthenon Senior Consultant | Strategy & Execution - Deal Technology
description: The opportunity At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value - solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY's full spectrum of services, we have reimagined strategic consulting for a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way. EY-Parthenon is looking for Senior Consultants to join our Nordic Strategy & Execution team, working on Deal Technology where technology is an investment thesis, a value creation lever and a transformation enabler, not just transaction support. This is more than a delivery role: deal technology is a fast-growing market with increasing demand, and our Nordic team is expanding rapidly. You will grow with it, from building your expertise to contributing to our offering, while supporting clients on IT due diligence, carve-outs, integrations and technology-led value creation at the intersection of AI, data, cloud, private equity and corporate transactions. Your key responsibilities As a Senior Consultant, you will own defined workstreams within complex, time-critical engagements. Working with engagement managers, investors and M&A teams, you will turn technology, data and AI questions into clear analysis and practical recommendations that connect to transaction logic and business value creation.     Conducting analyses and leading workstreams in IT and technology due diligence, and presenting decision-relevant insights to project leaders and clients.    Supporting carve-out, separation and integration programmes, including TSA design, IT disentanglement and Day 1 readiness.    Contributing to AI-enabled operating model transformation and technology-led growth initiatives across AI, data, cloud, digital platforms, applications and ERP.    Delivering your workstreams with quality and on time, while supporting junior colleagues and contributing to an inclusive, high-performing team. Skills and attributes for success     A relevant master's degree in business, economics, engineering, technology or a comparable field.    Relevant experience from strategy or management consulting, transaction advisory, M&A or complex technology-enabled change, including working in client teams and delivering defined workstreams.    Exposure to digital, data and AI or core IT, ERP and infrastructure, with an interest in developing across both areas and connecting technology choices to business outcomes.    A structured, hands-on approach, strong analytical and communication skills, and fluency in English. Ideally, you will also have     Experience from technology or IT in transactions, separations or integrations, or knowledge of ERP, cloud, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data or AI in a deal context.    Early experience of guiding junior colleagues or contributing to proposals and client opportunities.    Experience working with private equity investors or corporate M&A functions in the Nordics, plus a Nordic language. What we offer you     Complex, high-impact engagements with leading Nordic and international clients in transaction environments.    A collaborative, inclusive and entrepreneurial team culture with strong opportunities to learn and grow.    Modern offices in central Stockholm and Gothenburg, with flexible ways of working. Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon. Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. Application deadline: 22nd of November 2026. title: Construction Services Coordinator – Major Industrial Project
description: We are seeking a Site Service Coordinator to oversee and coordinate site support services for a major industrial construction project in northern Sweden.As part of the client’s project team, you will ensure that assigned services are planned, ordered, delivered and monitored in line with agreed scope, budget, schedule and quality standards.The position combines day-to-day coordination, contractor management and commercial follow-up. You will connect the site services organisation with main construction contractors and service providers. Regular on-site presence is essential to monitor delivery, address operational issues and maintain reliable documentation, cost tracking and performance reporting.Services may include temporary power and water, waste management, machinery support, road maintenance, dust control, snow clearance, equipment rental and other construction site support.Required Qualifications and Experience    Relevant technical or commercial education, or equivalent professional experience.    At least three years of experience in service coordination, contractor management or construction support, ideally within industrial or large-scale construction projects.    Experience working as part of an owner’s team or client organisation on industrial, construction or infrastructure projects.    Demonstrated ability to coordinate contractors and suppliers, covering planning, ordering, delivery follow-up and performance monitoring.    Experience coordinating temporary utilities, waste management, machinery services or comparable site support activities.    Good understanding of service scopes, agreements, work orders, call-offs and commercial contractual obligations.    Familiarity with Swedish construction contracts, procurement procedures and commercial follow-up.    Experience in cost control, invoice verification, documentation, reporting and KPI tracking.    Strong organisational, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate several service areas at once.    A structured, proactive and practical approach, with the ability to take ownership of issues and see them through to resolution.    Good awareness of health, safety, environment and quality requirements, including contractor responsibilities and interfaces with the client’s project team.    Professional proficiency in English.    Availability for regular on-site work in Luleå.Desirable Qualifications    Experience developing or improving service delivery processes, reporting procedures and contractor performance monitoring.    Familiarity with digital procurement, cost management and reporting tools, such as SAP, Kubicom, Power BI or equivalent systems.    Experience coordinating the mobilisation, demobilisation and handover of temporary site services across different construction phases.    Swedish language skills.Applitcation & Start Date:Start Date: 2026-11-02 title: Personlig assistent till ung kvinna i Umeå  fast schemarad ca 40 %
description: Om jobbetOm Provide Assistans. Vi är ett familjärt företag inom personlig assistans som är verksamma i Västerbotten. Vi hjälper människor, som är beviljad personlig assistans, att utifrån sina behov och önskemål kunna leva ett så rikt liv som man vill och kan. Våra grundvärderingar är inflytande, omtanke och kunskap. Dessa styr vår verksamhet i grunden och gör oss till det vi är. Det guidar såväl företaget som våra medarbetares vardag i mötet med kunder, samarbetspartners och kollegor. Vi tycker det är viktigt med hållbarhet, inkludering och jämställdhet. Vi vill definitivt vara med och bidra till en hållbar utveckling och göra vad vi kan för att minska vår egen klimatpåverkan genom att påverka de vi möter i vår egen verksamhet samt i vår närhet. Vi söker nu dig som vill vara med och skapa en varm, trygg och glädjefylld vardag för en ung kvinna i Umeå. Hon tycker om musik, dans, träna, att resa men också lugnare stunder med pyssel eller annat. Din roll blir att stötta henne i att fortsätta med det som får henne att må bra – rörelse, gemenskap, upplevelser och små stunder av vardagsglädje. Stödet handlar mycket om att vara lyhörd, närvarande och att bygga en trygg relation. Du kommer att hjälpa henne i kommunikationen och få möjlighet att lära dig förstå hennes sätt att uttrycka tankar, känslor och önskemål. Tillsammans får ni träna och utveckla kommunikationen i vardagen, vilket är en viktig del av uppdraget och hennes möjlighet till delaktighet och självbestämmande. I rollen ingår hjälp med personlig hygien, så det är viktigt att du känner dig bekväm med det. Hon har daglig verksamhet på vardagar, vilket innebär att arbetspassen främst är förlagda till andra tider. När du arbetar hos henne är du den som bidrar med lugn, trygghet, struktur och ett positivt bemötande. Om tjänsten    Fast schemarad på ca 40 %    Arbetspass förlagda till dag, kväll och natt med sovande jour    Utdrag ur belastningsregistret kommer att begäras innan anställning Vi tror att du:    Är varm, lyhörd och uppmärksam på individens behov.    Är väldigt flexibel och följsam, för den ena dagen är inte den andra lik.    Har god bussvana vad gäller ex Ultra- (Umeås lokaltrafik)    Är simkunnig för bad förekommer.    Tycker om att skapa delaktighet och uppmuntra till aktiviteter som ger glädje och livskvalitet.    Har tålamod och tycker att det är givande att utveckla kommunikation och samspel tillsammans med en annan person    Är trygg, ansvarstagande och engagerad Önskade kvalifikationer    Är varm, lyhörd och trygg i mötet med andra människor.    Har tålamod och tycker om att bygga relationer    Tycker om att skapa glädje, delaktighet och meningsfulla aktiviteter i vardagen    Har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift Meriterande:    Erfarenhet av personlig assistans, omsorg eller liknande arbete    Erfarenhet av AKK eller andra kommunikationsstöd Övrig information:    I det här uppdraget söker vi en kvinnlig assistent och stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.     Du behöver inte ha körkort!    Tillträde: 1 december och givetvis sker inskolning innan du går skarpt.    Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och har kollektivavtal. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vid frågor om tjänsten, är du varmt välkommen att kontakta: Andreas Elveljung, kundansvarig via info@provideassistans.seVarmt välkommen med din ansökan innehållande ett cv samt ett personligt brev.

title: Graduate ML Hardware Modelling Engineer
description: We have a fantastic opportunity to move into Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, key technologies for the future of computing. Working on innovative Arm IP, crafting technology that powers the next generation of mobile apps, portable devices, home automation, smart cities, self-driving cars, and much more!Arm is entering a new growth phase to develop innovative technologies and products for existing and new markets. We need hardworking and motivated people to join our team. Working with the world’s best companies as they build sector-leading products from our inventions, you’ll share ideas with and learn new skills from top engineers globally. We work in small teams, so your contributions will make a difference. This role offers the opportunity to lead, challenge the status quo, and ultimately change the world of ML and AI!What you might be working on as a Graduate?Our next generation NPU development begins on the HW modelling platform. As a graduate HW Modelling engineer, you will develop and build new features and assess their performance. You will collaborate closely with the ML HW design and verification teams, contributing to the architecture, specification, and verification of the product. You will also support the compiler team to ensure the HW runs efficiently and help maintain the model as an external deliverable in customer engagements.In the role of a Graduate Engineer, you are responsible for delivering well-tested, high-quality code for ML hardware modelling projects and will work together with hardware design and verification teams to debug problems and assist development.We are looking for individuals who:    Hold (or are on track to hold) a degree by the programme start date. Visa sponsorship support is also available for candidates who require it.In Return:You’ll receive a starting salary of SEK 545,000 (Bachelor level) or SEK 555,000 (Master level), alongside a comprehensive rewards package. title: Graduate ML Hardware Verification Engineer
description: Put programming skills to work on real hardware challenges! title: Senior Responsible AI Expert
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team       About this opportunityWe are looking for a Senior Responsible AI Expert to help strengthen AI governance, risk management and compliance across the organisation.In this role, you will support the responsible development and use of AI by evolving risk assessment frameworks, monitoring regulatory developments and helping teams apply relevant requirements in practice. You will work across legal, privacy, security, technology and business functions, providing trusted advice and supporting informed decision-making.The role is suited to someone who combines a strong understanding of AI regulations and standards with practical experience in governance, risk management and stakeholder engagement.   What you will do•    Lead the design, implementation and continuous improvement of AI risk assessment processes and frameworks.•    Monitor global AI regulations, including the EU AI Act, and help ensure that AI deployments align with applicable legal and ethical requirements.•    Develop and improve AI risk categorisation models, guardrails and assessment workflows.•    Advise AI risk owners and other stakeholders on compliance requirements, risk management and appropriate controls.•    Provide strategic recommendations and decision support on AI-related risks and opportunities.•    Lead awareness initiatives, stakeholder communications and training related to AI risk and responsible AI.•    Work with platform and technology teams to support automated AI risk tracking and monitoring.•    Contribute to the ongoing development of AI governance, oversight and compliance practices across the organisation.   You will bring•    Professional experience in AI governance, compliance and risk management.•    A strong understanding of AI regulations, including the EU AI Act, as well as relevant global policies, standards and frameworks.•    Experience developing or applying AI risk assessment frameworks, controls or governance processes.•    The ability to lead complex initiatives and collaborate effectively across legal, privacy, security, technology and business teams.•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex requirements into practical guidance.•    Confidence advising stakeholders and communicating AI risks and compliance topics clearly to different audiences.•    Experience working in a regulated industry, such as telecommunications, financial services or healthcare, is an advantage.

title: Corporate Legal Counsel - Security, AB Volvo
description: Company description:The Volvo Group drives prosperity through transport and infrastructure solutions, offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. FThe Volvo Group is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, employs almost 100.000 people and serves customers in more than 190 markets. Job description: Legal Counsel, AB Volvo   We are now looking for a Legal Counsel to strengthen our legal team within Treasury and Capital Markets. Your focus areas will include contributing to the protection of the Group’s critical assets, including people, products, information and assets, including physical, digital and brand assets. The role will also provide high-quality legal support across a broad range of operational, corporate governance and regulatory matters. The position offers:     a varied role in a fast-paced department, with exciting challenges for people passionate about their work      the opportunity to work with a high executive level in a global environment, together with highly skilled colleagues      learning and development opportunities in line with Group ambitions        a friendly, collaborative and professional working environment, where your personal contribution will make a difference.       The Group Corporate Legal team     Group Corporate Legal is one of three legal departments of the Volvo Group headquarters. We are a team of ten legal professionals in Gothenburg that supports the Group General Counsel with management of matters involving significant legal risks for the Group as well as expert legal advice on a broad range of operational and strategic matters, including Group disclosures and reporting, governance, treasury & finance, crisis & security management and ESG matters. The Legal & Compliance function takes pride in enabling fair business. We are trusted strategic partners to the business, safeguarding the Volvo Group Code of Conduct Wherever we are in the Volvo Group, we:       have a business mindset, working proactively and looking for solutions      are trusted partners with integrity and independence, daring to give unwelcome advice when needed      are engaged team players, supporting each other      continue to learn and develop to stay ahead, being open minded and welcoming feedback      strive to excel in our everyday work, being empowered to act and taking full responsibility for legal and compliance risk management       Some of the things you will do as a Legal Counsel include:       Leading and supporting Group-wide implementation projects relating to security and other related legislation, including cybersecurity, data, foreign direct investment and emergency preparedness regulations     Supporting the development and maintenance of incident-reporting processes and other Group-wide security risk management and compliance systems     Actively managing security incidents as part of a crisis-management team     Together with the Group purchasing function negotiate agreements for the procurement of security-related technology and software, and providing other legal support to the Group Security function as required     Participating in internal steering and reporting forums, including relevant data security and privacy committees     Engaging and coordinating high-quality external legal counsel, and developing networks and other channels to remain informed of legal and regulatory developments in the security field     Supporting the Group on a broad range of topics within Corporate Legal’s responsibilities, including corporate, governance, reporting and stock market matters      Profile description:  You should have:       A university degree in law     At least five years of relevant legal experience gained at a reputable law firm and/or in an in-house legal role, preferably within the automotive, telecommunications or technology industries     A strong interest in business operations and an ambition to learn and develop expertise in new areas as the automotive industry transforms     A proven ability to analyze and solve complex problems in an international environment     Excellent communication skills and professional proficiency in English You may also have experience as in-house counsel, preferably from a listed company and/or from compliance or legal operations. Improving ways of working and finding solutions is part of our everyday job, so work will require a bias for action and a can-do attitude. And with people at the center of what we do, you will need to be keen to engage with team members and others and build relationships to thrive in the role. The position reports to the SVP Head of Group Corporate Legal. Travel will be required occasionally. If you have questions, please contact: Ulf Rapp, Senior Vice President Group Legal, ulf.rapp@volvo.com. Last application date is November 25, 2026. As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testingmay be conducted. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

title: Full-Stack Developer  Marketing Automation - 20619
description: Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewRole SummaryOur client is seeking a senior full-stack developer to join a cross-functional team responsible for developing and enhancing Marketing Automation solutions. The role has clear ownership of the development and maintenance of services, integrations, email templates, landing pages, and personalized content components. You will collaborate closely with platform owners and business stakeholders to deliver a consistent, accessible, user-friendly, and high-performing experience.As a senior member of the team, you will provide technical guidance, share knowledge, and help improve engineering practices and solution design. Development will be driven by business requirements, non-functional requirements, and defined acceptance criteria.Key Responsibilities    Design, develop, test, and maintain frontend and backend services supporting the Marketing Automation environment.    Create responsive and accessible email templates, landing pages, and personalized content blocks.    Design and implement integrations and APIs between the Marketing Automation platform and surrounding systems.    Develop and test SOAP and REST APIs, including opportunities for API test automation.    Use customer and campaign data to support personalization, segmentation, and relevant targeted communications.    Optimize application and interface performance while ensuring usability and accessibility.    Perform testing, troubleshooting, defect resolution, logging, and monitoring, and introduce test automation where appropriate.    Translate business requirements, non-functional requirements, and acceptance criteria into maintainable technical solutions.    Manage source code, continuous integration and delivery workflows, and backlog-related engineering activities.    Provide technical leadership, mentor colleagues, share expertise, and contribute to the continuous improvement of team practices and solutions.Technical Stack & Requirements    Frontend: JavaScript ES6 or later, HTML5, CSS3, and React or Vue.js.    Backend and integration: Server-side JavaScript, system integrations, API design and implementation, REST, and SOAP.    Data: SQL, including writing and executing SQL scripts.    Engineering tools: Git, Webpack or equivalent build tooling, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and backlog management.    UX and design: Fundamental UX design knowledge and experience with Figma or an equivalent design tool.    Ways of working: Strong experience with Lean-Agile delivery methods; SAFe experience is preferred.    Advantageous platform experience: Adobe Campaign Classic v8 or another Marketing Automation platform, including campaign management, segmentation, personalization, content blocks, email templates, and landing pages.    Advantageous test automation: Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or Jest, as well as automated API testing.    Additional advantageous knowledge: System-level security requirements, server configuration, troubleshooting, logging, and monitoring.Qualifications & ExperienceThe assignment requires 4–8 years of full-stack development experience covering both frontend and backend engineering. Candidates must have documented JavaScript experience and practical knowledge of React or Vue.js, together with a track record of delivering responsive, accessible, user-friendly, and performance-optimized interfaces. Experience designing integrations between Marketing Automation platforms and other systems is required, as is experience developing and testing SOAP and REST APIs.Strong SQL knowledge, modern web development experience, source control proficiency, and familiarity with Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices are expected. Experience with Marketing Automation platforms, Adobe Campaign Classic v8, frontend or API test automation, system security, and operational troubleshooting is advantageous. Certifications in web development or Marketing Automation and previous experience in banking or financial services are also beneficial.The successful consultant should be able to work independently while contributing effectively to a cross-functional team. The role requires a structured and proactive approach, strong analytical capability, an understanding of complex flows and dependencies, and the ability to communicate technical recommendations clearly. Senior-level technical leadership, constructive challenge of existing practices, and active knowledge sharing are important aspects of the assignment. Professional fluency in both Swedish and English is required.

perspectives.    Strong analytical and organisational skills, with experience managing complex procurement activities and decision-making processes.    Ability to work independently, prioritise effectively, and maintain progress in dynamic environments.    Experience ensuring procurement quality, governance, compliance, and transparency.    Strong stakeholder management skills and experience collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.    High integrity and sound judgement when handling commercially sensitive and confidential information.    A relevant university or college degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Law, IT, or equivalent professional experience.🌟 Personal QualitiesTo succeed in this role, you are commercially minded, analytical, structured, and proactive.You are confident communicating with both technical specialists and senior decision-makers, and you have the ability to build trust, challenge constructively, and drive procurement activities forward.You thrive in complex organisations, enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders, and can balance strategic priorities with operational delivery.📍 Assignment Details    Location: Solna (Stockholm) or Gothenburg, Sweden    Start date: 9 November 2026    End date: 30 April 2027    Please note that your CV must be submitted in English.Sway Sourcing är en Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

title: Head of Public Affairs at Volvo CE
description: Company description:Volvo Construction Equipment Job description:    The construction equipment industry is undergoing a major transformation. Electrification, digitalization, sustainability ambitions, industrial policy and geopolitical developments are reshaping the conditions for our industry. At Volvo Construction Equipment (Volvo CE), we are committed to driving this transformation and building the world we want to live in for our customers, employees and society.  We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented Head of Public Affairs to shape the external policy environment, strengthen strategic partnerships and translate political and regulatory developments into business opportunities.  This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of business strategy, technology, geopolitics and public policy in one of the world's leading industrial companies. You will advise senior executives on developments shaping our industry, represent Volvo CE in influential external arenas and help define the conditions for future competitiveness and sustainable growth.      What you will do   As Head of Public Affairs, you will lead Volvo CE's Global Public Affairs agenda, serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership and represent the company in dialogues with policymakers, regulators and other key stakeholders.  Working closely with Volvo Group Public Affairs and colleagues across Volvo CE, you will ensure that our business priorities are reflected in relevant policy discussions and advocacy initiatives.  Your key responsibilities will include: Shape and execute our Public Affairs agenda: Develop and implement Volvo CE's Public Affairs strategy in close coordination with Volvo Group Public Affairs, aligned with business priorities and long-term competitiveness.  Anticipate,  interpret and influence external developments: Monitor, analyze and influence political, regulatory, economic and geopolitical developments across Swedish, European and international arenas. Translate insights from policy, industry trends, research and broader societal developments into business opportunities and strategic guidance.   Advise senior leadership: Provide actionable insights on political, regulatory and geopolitical developments, supporting business strategy and executive stakeholder engagement.  Lead strategic advocacy: Develop evidence-based policy positions, advocacy plans and key messages in close collaboration with strategy, technology, sustainability, communications, legal and commercial functions.  Build trusted partnerships: Develop and maintain relationships with policymakers, government authorities, industry associations, NGOs, think tanks and customers, positioning Volvo CE as a trusted and constructive partner in the transition towards more sustainable and productive solutions.  Drive external engagement: Represent Volvo CE in industry forums, policy discussions, executive roundtables and strategic external engagements, acting as a trusted ambassador for the company among influential stakeholders in Sweden, Europe and globally.  Strengthen Group-wide collaboration: Coordinate Volvo CE's contributions to Volvo Group Public Affairs initiatives and policy positions, ensuring alignment with Group priorities while advancing the interests of the construction equipment business.      Who are you?   You are a strategic, proactive and results-oriented professional who combines political understanding with sound business judgment.  You build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders, communicate complex issues clearly and drive results through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority.  You are comfortable working independently in an international environment, balancing long-term strategic objectives with effective execution. You have a genuine interest in understanding the forces shaping society, business and industry, and enjoy staying ahead of developments through policy analysis, research, global trends and geopolitical developments.  Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to Volvo CE's competitiveness and the transformation of the construction equipment industry.  We are looking for an experienced Public Affairs professional with strong political judgment, business acumen and a proven ability to influence policy outcomes.  To be successful in this role, we believe you bring:       Significant relevant experience, ideally in Public Affairs, government relations, regulatory affairs or a related strategic function, gained in industry, government or relevant organizations.      Strong knowledge of Swedish and European political institutions, regulatory frameworks and decision-making processes, with an international perspective.      Proven experience in developing advocacy strategies, influencing policy developments and advising senior executives.      Solid business and industrial understanding, with the ability to connect political and regulatory developments to business strategy and commercial opportunities.      A relevant university degree in political science, law, economics, business administration, engineering or a related field.      Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with fluency in English & Swedish.   Additional merits include:       Experience from construction equipment, automotive, transport, energy or other industrial sectors.      Established networks within relevant political institutions, government agencies and industry organizations.      Experience working with EU industrial, climate, trade or competitiveness policies.

title: Construction & Facilities Manager (12-Month Parental Cover)
description: We’re looking for a Construction & Facilities Manager to plan, coordinate, and manage how Axel Arigato physical spaces are built, refurbished, and maintained - from stores to showrooms and pop-ups. Do you like seeing a project through from first plan to opening day, on time and on budget? You’ll own the budget for these spaces, working closely with contractors, landlords and teams across the business to keep each one safe, functional and well maintained. It’s a year of growth: three new US projects are live, and European expansion into the UK is underway. Come join us.WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FORThis role suits someone who stays calm under pressure and is organized by default. You plan carefully, follow through, and keep contractors, landlords and colleagues aligned when timelines get tight. You’re comfortable managing external partners across several markets, you hold suppliers to a clear standard, and you look for ways to make each project run smoother than the last.WHAT YOU WILL DO    Own time schedules, RACI, budgets, labor and risk mitigation plans for every construction and refurbishment project.    Lead projects from start to close-out, coordinating subcontractors and keeping landlords, contractors and internal stakeholders updated on progress.    Review, adapt and execute lease, supplier and maintenance agreements through a transparent procurement process that reduces business risk.    Run snag, punch and QC reports and follow up on execution, so every store opens to standard.    Manage preventive and corrective maintenance with our facilities partners in the US and EU, tracking both performance and cost.    Bring commercial design feedback into each project to keep store quality and customer experience consistent.    Set and follow up department goals each quarter, making responsibilities clear and ensuring tools and resources to deliver.    Partner with other departments to share knowledge and improve how we work together.ARE YOU THE ONE?We seek people with most of the following:    A background in building and construction, through PMP or similar training in construction or facilities management, or 5+ years of experience in retail construction or facilities management.    Experience leading a team or working in a similar role.    A solid understanding of construction and maintenance requirements for commercial spaces.    Experience managing external service providers across multiple markets.    Strong time management and clear, confident verbal communication.    A problem-solving mindset and the initiative to act on it.    Familiarity with lean and/or agile ways of working.    Confidence in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, with AutoCAD, SketchUp or Asana as a plus.HERE’S HOW TO APPLYIf you want to shape how our physical spaces are built and cared for, we’d love to hear from you.Apply by submitting your CV in English. Please do not include a photo or date of birth with your application; our recruitment process is competency-based.We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.CONTRACT TYPE & START DATEEstimated starting date: January 2027. Contract type: Fixed-term contract for 12 months, covering parental leave. Full-time. Location: Gothenburg, Sweden. On-site at our central office.A BIT ABOUT AXEL ARIGATOFounded in Sweden in 2014 by Albin Johansson and Max Svärdh, Axel Arigato was born with a disruptive mindset, modernising and democratising the sneaker landscape through a blend of style, quality, community and a digital-first approach.Grounded in Scandinavian minimalism and elevated with playful, intentional details, every piece is designed with care: crafted to move globally, worn with individuality.What began online expanded into physical spaces built for energetic cultural exchange: stores and experiences where conversations, performances and unexpected activations dissolve the boundaries between brand and culture.Today, Axel Arigato continues to evolve with purpose via a people-powered approach. It shows up where culture happens: on streets, at events and across cities.Built on curiosity. Driven by connection.OUR VALUESDROP: Diversity, Respect, Openness and Passion are our core values. They are the foundation for our current state and what we will always bring with us to the future.

title: Senior Logistics Technician
description: Senior Logistics TechnicianOverviewAs a Senior Logistics Technician, known at Microsoft as a Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT), you will help keep datacenter operations running smoothly by coordinating inventory and asset management activities. You will prioritise work, guide other technicians, resolve issues, and help ensure equipment is received, tracked, moved, and dispatched accurately and safely.You will join Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, which supports the infrastructure behind services including Azure, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Bing. This role offers opportunities to develop your technical expertise, contribute to process improvements, and grow your mentoring skills.Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organisation on the planet to achieve more. We bring a growth mindset to our work and build an inclusive culture grounded in respect, integrity, and accountability.Responsibilities    Prioritise ticket queues and assign work to technicians, resolving or escalating issues that could delay inventory and asset management activities.    Guide technicians through inbound and outbound logistics tasks, including deliveries, purchase order receiving, equipment movements, and shipment documentation.    Coordinate with third-party warehouses, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), suppliers, and internal teams to support timely deliveries and collections.    Maintain accurate inventory records and help the team investigate and resolve discrepancies.    Use your knowledge of processes and systems to support complex requests, clear blockers, and improve service quality.    Serve as a subject matter expert for the Return Merchandise Authorisation (RMA) process, guiding the team in handling failed hardware in line with established procedures.    Coordinate the scheduling of data-bearing device destruction or shredding with senior leadership and ensure the team follows required security procedures.    Support technicians during periods of high activity and provide practical guidance when issues arise.    Participate in or lead daily safety briefings, complete required training, and promote safe working practices for lifting, rack movement, equipment operation, and use of personal protective equipment (PPE).    Identify opportunities to simplify, improve, or automate inventory and logistics processes.    Demonstrate accountability for accurate, safe, and high-quality work while embodying Microsoft’s culture and values.Required Qualifications    High school diploma or equivalent and experience in warehouse operations, supply chain, inventory management, retail, logistics, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.Preferred Qualifications    Experience in IT logistics, inventory and asset management, or warehouse and supply chain operations in a large organisation.    Experience using equipment to move heavy loads, such as forklifts, pallet jacks, or chassis lifts.    Experience guiding colleagues, coordinating work, or resolving operational escalations.Background Check RequirementsThis role requires the ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements. The successful candidate must pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Learning support teacher
description: Job DescriptionWe are seeking a full-time, experienced Learning Support Teacher to work with a diverse range of students. This role is crucial in providing targeted assistance to students who may be facing challenges in their academic journey. The Learning Support position involves working closely with students, teachers, and parents to create an inclusive and supportive learning environment. We welcome applications from all nationalities. You must be fluent in English. Knowledge of French and/or another language is an advantage.Main Duties● To assist and support individual pupil(s) on the SEND register by planning, preparing and delivering lessons, assessing pupil progress and planning the next steps (28 periods a week)● To plan eff ectively to meet the needs of individual pupils with Special Educational Needs and, in collaboration with the Learning Support Coordinator (LSCO), prepare, implement, monitor and review Individual Educational Plans● To deliver focused support lessons, specifi cally focused on English language acquisition and preparation for Cambridge English Examinations● To make or modify resources as suggested and advised by the LSCO, Educational Psychologist or other outside agencies● To work in partnership with the parents to promote their involvement in working with the school to achieve the best outcome for the pupil(s)● Identify and share the most eff ective teaching approaches for pupils with additional learning support needs● To work as part of the team to ensure that the well-being and personal development of the pupils enhance their learning opportunities and life skills● To provide regular feedback to the Class teacher / Subject teacher / KS Lead / LSCO and relevant outside agencies (as directed) about the pupils’ diffi culties and progress● To assess and monitor pupil progress and plan next steps for children on the SEND registerPerson Specifi cation● Good honours degree and/or a further degree in a directly related subject.● Has experience working with young people in a boarding school setting. Shares the educational vision of La Garenne International School including our holistic vision of education and is excited to contribute to the co-curricular and pastoral aspects of life at the school.● Embraces a commitment to working within the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion.● Embraces developments and innovations in teaching and learning and is willing to experiment with new practices.● Is passionate about their subject and can enthuse others.● Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (native-level)● Has strong interpersonal skills.● Understands the importance of Safeguarding and keeping all students safe.● Has a good honours degree or relevant equivalent qualifi cation.● Has excellent written and verbal communication skills.● Strong ICT competence and willingness to embrace new technologies.● Can support our after-school programme.● Is reliable and organised.● Shares our vision of holistic education and is excited to contribute to the co-curricular and pastoral life of the school.● Is proactive and continually strives for improvement.● Possesses a positive outlook, an optimistic approach to change and development, and a good sense of humour.How to ApplyWe welcome applicants who have a passion for education, who are ready to off er individual attention, participate in the life of the whole school and who will uphold our Guiding Principles.La Garenne International School is fully committed to safeguarding the children and young people in our care. All new staff are subject to enhanced pre-employment clearance, including criminal records and Swiss Justice Department searches for people working with children, as well as identity, qualifi cations and employment verifi cation.Please send the following documents by email to hr@la-garenne.ch or by post to the address below:● Full curriculum vitae.● A letter of application, preferably handwritten.● A copy of your passport information page and/or Swiss work permit.● Names and contact details of at least two referees for your last two jobs.

title: Automechaniker - Installation Specialist
description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0--- Automechaniker \- Installation Specialist=========================================Möchtest du ein wichtiger Teil unserer Wachstumsgeschichte in der Schweiz sein und gleichzeitig nachhaltige Mobilität fördern, indem du unseren Kund:innen hilfst, Autos zu teilen?Über GoMore:-------------Wir sind seit Oktober 2021 in der Schweiz tätig und unser Ziel ist es, der führende Mobilitätsanbieter in unserem neuen Markt zu werden. GoMore unterstützt bereits mehr als 3 Millionen Mitglieder beim Teilen von Autos in Dänemark, Schweden, Spanien, Finnland, der Schweiz und Österreich.Wir suchen dich!----------------GoMore sucht per sofort eine(n) internen Mechaniker:in 90\-100% für die Installation und Deinstallation von unseren Keyless\-Geräten in Fahrzeugen, die bei GoMore vermietet werden. In der als Installations\-Spezialist:in wirst du zu den Kund:innen fahren und Keyless\-Geräte installieren, damit die Fahrzeuge problemlos über die GoMore\-Plattform mit dem GoMore Keyless\-System geteilt werden können.Die ist remote und du wirst kein physisches Büro haben. Du wirst daher deinen Arbeitstag selbst planen und Installationen und Deinstallationen von Keyless\-Geräten organisieren. Die tägliche Arbeit findet hauptsächlich in Zürich und Umgebung statt und es kann nach deiner Planung variieren. Die Arbeitszeiten variieren je nach den Bedürfnissen der Kunden und können von dir geplant werden.Neben der täglichen Arbeit als Mechaniker:in in der Schweiz wirst du als Installations\-Spezialist:in der/die interne Installations\-Expert:in von GoMore sein und andere Partner:innen und Mechaniker:innen in der Schweiz sowie in den anderen europäischen Märkten von GoMore unterstützen. Business Intelligence Manager à 100 %
======================================

**L’Hôpital de La Tour** est un établissement de soins aigus de haut niveau, privé, indépendant et à dimension humaine. Ancré dans sa mission de restaurer la meilleure qualité de vie possible pour ses patients, l’Hôpital de La Tour place l’amélioration continue, l’excellence médicale et l’accompagnement de ses collaborateurs au cœur de ses priorités. L’institution emploie plus de 1’200 collaborateurs, représentant plus de 60 métiers, et collabore avec plus de 550 médecins agréés.  

Nous **recrutons un/e**

**Business Intelligence Manager à 100 % (ref : 2029\)**
--------------------------------------------------------

 

**Vous souhaitez conjuguer expertise BI, proximité avec les métiers et impact stratégique dans un environnement en pleine transformation ?**

Créée il y a six ans, la fonction Business Intelligence de l’Hôpital de La Tour accompagne aujourd’hui **plus de 100 utilisateurs au moyen de plus de 100 tableaux de bord**, alimentés par une douzaine de systèmes sources.

La fonction entre dans une nouvelle phase de son développement : migration de la plateforme de données, renforcement des données externes, analyses prédictives et création d’un portail destiné aux médecins.

Rattaché·e au CFO, vous êtes **l’interlocuteur ou l’interlocutrice privilégié·e de l’institution sur les sujets BI**. Vous assurez la continuité de l’unité tout en structurant son évolution et en renforçant la place de la data dans les processus décisionnels.

 

Votre rôle
-----------

À l’interface entre stratégie, technologie et métiers, vous pilotez une activité BI à fort impact et transformez les données en leviers concrets d’aide à la décision.

### Pilotage et développement de la BI

* Recueillir les besoins des métiers et développer de nouveaux tableaux de bord Power BI en lien avec la stratégie de l’Hôpital.
* Faire évoluer les sources de données avec la DSIO et contribuer à la migration de la plateforme.
* Contribuer au développement des analyses prédictives et du portail médecins.
* Renforcer la structure par le recrutement d’un adjoint et d’un stagiaire.


### Analyse et aide à la décision

* Réaliser des analyses ad hoc et stratégiques, notamment sur la facturation, les flux de patients et l’efficience de la dotation.
* Présenter les analyses aux directions et contribuer au pilotage de l’institution.
* Automatiser les traitements et les productions statistiques, notamment OFS et REKOLE.
* Intervenir sur des domaines variés : finance, facturation, ressources humaines, soins stationnaires et ambulatoires, pharmacie, codage médical, achats, qualité et médico\-technique.


### Gouvernance et qualité des données

* Gérer les droits d’accès et la sécurité des données : groupes, rôles et filtres par périmètre.
* Assurer la maintenance des tableaux de bord, les contrôles de qualité et les corrections nécessaires.
* Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’interprétation des données et répondre aux demandes quotidiennes des services.
* Mettre en place un système de ticketing afin de structurer et prioriser les demandes.


Pourquoi rejoindre ce projet ?
------------------------------

* Prendre la responsabilité d’une fonction BI déjà solidement implantée dans l’institution.
* Piloter une nouvelle étape de transformation de la plateforme de données.
* Travailler au contact direct de la direction générale, du contrôle de gestion, de la DSIO et des responsables de services.
* Contribuer à des décisions ayant un impact concret sur les activités médicales, administratives et opérationnelles.
* Développer une équipe et structurer durablement l’activité BI.
* Rejoindre un établissement privé, indépendant et à dimension humaine.


 

Votre profil
------------

* Master ou bachelor universitaire ou HES en informatique, informatique de gestion, statistique, économie ou domaine équivalent.
* Minimum cinq ans d’expérience en business intelligence ou en analyse de données. Une expérience dans le secteur de la santé constitue un atout.
* Maîtrise de SQL et d’un outil de dashboarding tel que Power BI, Qlik, Looker ou Tableau.
* Maîtrise de R ou de Python et bonne maîtrise d’Excel.
* Capacité à comprendre les enjeux métiers et à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs non spécialistes.
* Rigueur, autonomie, sens des priorités et discrétion.
* Excellente maîtrise du français.


Envie de faire grandir la BI avec nous ?
----------------------------------------

Rejoignez l’Hôpital de La Tour et contribuez à transformer la donnée en décisions utiles, fiables et porteuses de valeur pour l’ensemble de l’institution.

Nous nous réjouissons de découvrir votre candidature.
